runtime.control_panel: loopback HTTP, session token, human-reviewed mutations
runtime.source_build: npm ci, then npm run pack:standalone inside agent-bridge
runtime.source_pin: Exact HEAD, dirty flag and input tree hashes are recorded in release.json at build time.

skill.installation: ~/.agents/skills/thorvision-framelab plus thin thorvision-analytics compatibility alias; Codex also receives project-local copies
skill.source_pin: The default skill snapshot is versioned by the desktop commit. Original provenance and input hashes are in skills/SNAPSHOT.json. Exact HEAD, dirty flag and skill tree hash are recorded in release.json.

device.ownership: Developer-predeployed service; end users connect using the device API.
device.deployment: See DEVICE-DEPLOYMENT.md; device OS/native capture build is a separate prerequisite, not installed by PC setup.
device.verification: Baseline from 2026-11-03 audit, not a fresh device inspection in this curation.
device.baseline_note: Recorded pre-rename source commit; FrameLab deployment must record its actual source tree and verification separately.

desktop_optional.note: Standalone MCP/WebUI does not require Qt, GStreamer or desktop provider adapters on the PC.

verification.opencode_live_trial: User reported successful MCP stack trial on 2026-11-04; model identity/performance not independently remeasured.
verification.windows_x64_packaged_install: See docs/build-verification-2026-11-09.md in the desktop repository for this source's local checks.

publication: No CI upload, package registry publication, Git push, or device restart is performed by this recipe.
